description: This PHP class defines the CandidateAttachment entity for a Human Resource Management system, mapping it to the database table 'ohrm_job_candidate_attachment'. It includes properties for attachment metadata such as filename, content, type, and associated candidate, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CandidateAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing an attachment associated with a candidate, mapped to 'ohrm_job_candidate_attachment' table, with properties for id, candidate reference, filename, type, size, and content.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate object associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate object with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type (MIME or similar) of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file (possibly as resource or string).

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Returns the type of attachment, if specified.
